transcript.text: Bosch WTN85201GB condenser dryer not drying properly anymore, clothes still damp after 2 hrs. any ideas

That model is a heat-pump dryer, which relies on good airflow to dry clothes efficiently. The most common reason for damp laundry after two hours is restricted airflow due to blocked filters or the condenser unit. Please switch off and unplug the machine first, then check the lint filter in the door opening and remove the condenser unit from behind the bottom flap to rinse it under a tap. Let me know if they were clogged with fluff or if they looked clean.

Door filters had fluff and a waxy film, water barely went through until I scrubbed them. Condenser at the bottom had never been cleaned and the front was matted with lint, but it rinsed clean with the shower head. Also vacuumed fluff out of the slot behind it. What next?

Since they are now clean, the next most common cause for poor drying on this model is either residual moisture on the filters/condenser (which can happen if you refitted them while damp) or coated moisture sensors inside the drum that stop the cycle early. Please wipe the metal sensor strips with a damp cloth and a little white vinegar to remove any remaining residue, ensure everything is bone dry before putting it back together, and run another normal programme. If they are still damp after this, we should check how wet your clothes were coming out of the washing machine.
Wiped the sensor bars with vinegar (they were a bit dull) and ran a test cycle. Clothes dried in about 100 minutes and the container was nearly full. Seems sorted?

Yes, that sounds exactly right. The combination of a blocked lint filter and a dirty condenser was restricting the airflow enough to stop the heat-pump system from working efficiently. Cleaning those components restored the necessary air circulation, which is why your test cycle completed successfully in 100 minutes. To keep it running well, try to empty the lint filter after every use and give the condenser a quick rinse every few months. If you have any other questions or need help with anything else, just let me know.
